caption: The drawing features a single, ornately designed armchair centered on the page. The chair has a dark brown wooden frame with intricate carved detailing at the top of the backrest and on the front apron. The upholstery is a light beige or tan color with green and pink floral embroidery on the backrest and seat, as well as green piping outlining the backrest and seat edges. The armrests have padded upholstery matching the seat and backrest, and the legs are curved in a classic style. Surrounding the main image of the chair, there are two smaller rectangular insets: the upper right inset shows a pencil sketch of a decorative shawl or crest from the chair's backrest, and the lower left inset contains a pencil sketch of one of the chair’s elegantly shaped legs. All elements are drawn within faint rectangular guidelines on a cream-colored background.
title: Armchair
